 Things haven’t gone positively for Sam Houston for much of the last two years, but they have one final opportunity to fix it in front of the home fans.
 Sam Houston will honor its senior class ahead of the game, as the Bearkats are still looking for their first win against an FBS opponent in 371 days. Sam Houston will try to find that win against a Middle Tennessee team trying to clinch bowl eligibility before the final week.
